g.text: How many agents may run at the same time.
Give each agent its own git worktree and branch sm/<task>.
What new agent branches start from (HEAD or a branch name).
What agents run by default: claude or codex. A task can say otherwise.
Branch an agent merges its work into when you approve at the end (empty = whatever branch
Delete a task's worktree once it is done or cancelled (the branch keeps the work). A
worktree with uncommitted changes is kept.
Copy a session's transcript into .supermanager/agents/<id>/transcripts/ when it ends
When a task changes supermanager itself, restart this workspace with the new code once
the agent is done (its agents keep running).
Default model for agents (empty = the tool's default), e.g. opus, or gpt-6-astra for
Default effort for agents (empty = the tool's default). claude:
Let you choose 'bypass permissions' when approving an agent's plan.
